markscheme.marking_summary: Exact original MS leaf excerpt: Award [2 max] Award [1] per point; an integrated database is one that holds data for several applications; the data is standardized and shared (with systems using API); Extract, Transfer, Load (ETL) is carried out (for data standardizing). an integrated database is one that has multiple sources/databases; the data is converted into a standard structure (using API); Extract, Transfer, Load (ETL) is carried out (for data standardizing).
